scope: D3 TRAIN corpus only; benchmark DEV and frozen TEST prohibited
split: same episode-level 12% validation split used by jenga_w6_simple.py
representation: 15-dimensional residual between physical and D2 global log-gap curves: five nested levels by action/early-hold/late-hold phases
router: future-informed nearest correction prototype at evaluation; balanced-capacity hard assignment during prototype fitting
task_information: no topple, failure, object identity, task success, benchmark DEV, or TEST labels

optimization.algorithm: capacity-balanced hard k-means via linear-sum assignment

primary_metrics: held-out adjacent-level local scale Huber loss

feasibility_gate.interpretation: all conditions must pass before implementing a causal router
